Push mot tham chieu Instance moi cho cung reference Instance ben duoi va tra ve no.

## Cú pháp

```lua
cloneref(instance: Instance): Instance
```

## Alias

- `clonereference`

## Đối số

| Name | Type | Required | Mô tả |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `instance` | `Instance` | Yes | Instance object duoc dung lam nguon cho tham chieu moi. |

## Giá trị trả về

| Name | Type | Mô tả |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `reference` | `Instance` | Tham chieu Instance duoc tra ve sau khi Instance cache chay voi reference object goc. |

## Ví dụ

Tao mot tham chieu Instance khac tu Instance object hien co.

```lua
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local reference = cloneref(Players)
print(reference)

local sameAlias = clonereference(Players)
print(sameAlias)
```
